Amount.description: A quantity of exactly one asset. ``value`` / ``raw`` may be unknown.

asset.description: Asset id the amount is denominated in
asset.title: Asset

unit.description: raw = integer base units, decimal = decimal-adjusted token units
unit.title: Unit

value.description: Numeric value as a string; null when unknown
value.title: Value

expression.description: Symbolic expression, e.g. a source expression
expression.title: Expression

Amount.title: Amount

symbol.description: Display only; never used to relate assets
symbol.title: Symbol

issuer.description: Entity id that issues / accounts for this asset
issuer.title: Issuer

AssetIdentity.description: How the asset is identified. Display names are never used for identity.
AssetIdentity.title: AssetIdentity

Basis.description:
Where a fact comes from. ``static`` facts are candidate behaviour that
the code supports; ``observed`` facts were seen in a concrete execution.
Basis.title: Basis

Boundary.description: A place where the analysis stops (e.g. only an interface is available).
Boundary.title: Boundary

negated.description: True if the guarded step runs when the expression is false
negated.title: Negated

expression.description: Address expression this entity stands for
expression.title: Expression

actor.description: Entity that must perform / trigger the step
actor.title: Actor

optional.description: Step only runs under a branch condition
optional.title: Optional

Flow.description:
One asset movement inside an operation. ``from_``/``to`` may be null for
mint (no payer) and burn (no recipient).

from.description: Payer entity id; null for mint
from.title: From

to.description: Recipient entity id; null for burn
to.title: To

mechanism.description: transfer, transferFrom, mint, burn, native, adapter ...
mechanism.title: Mechanism

conditions.description: Condition ids of the parent operation
conditions.title: Conditions

Flow.title: Flow

transaction.description: Relation to the parent: executed in the same transaction or a separate one
transaction.title: Transaction

initiator.description: Entity that calls / triggers the operation
initiator.title: Initiator

role.description: caller, payer, receiver, owner, share_receiver, keeper, ...
role.title: Role

counterparty.description: For debt / collateral: the entity owed to
counterparty.title: Counterparty

Provenance.description: Pipeline record so a wrong relation can be traced to its stage.
Provenance.title: Provenance

source.description: Node id (entity, asset, position or operation)
source.title: Source

rule.description: Rule or adapter id that produced this item
rule.title: Rule

view.description: Suggested view: flows, holdings, dependencies, all
view.title: View

answer.description: Expected answer, for checking the interaction
answer.title: Answer
